author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Also as college students it's your duty to never say no to free Pizza so you need to show up and sounds like people who have job connections will be there.

#Healthtech and #Fintech seem to be making some noises...but most "decentralized app" problems are not problems to solve.

Just remember the java developer is the most highly paid person (behind a product manager) for a reason...mainly government and public sector move at snails pace not sure the Blockchain hype can withstand the long game of government....

Think there will be a role in blockchain technology in finance and health maybe....still say human readable data beats all.
